fin3_list_accounts.name: Cash and Bank
fin3_list_accounts.description: Parent of all bank, cash and clearing accounts.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Operating Bank Account
fin3_list_accounts.description: Main studio bank account (base currency).

fin3_list_accounts.name: Cash on Hand
fin3_list_accounts.description: Physical cash.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Business Reserve Account
fin3_list_accounts.description: Optional physical account for the operating reserve. The reserve itself is a logical allocation, not a ledger account.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Online Payments Clearing
fin3_list_accounts.description: Money collected by a payment provider and not yet settled to the bank. Provider-neutral. Accepts any currency (each currency balances by itself).

fin3_list_accounts.name: Accounts Receivable
fin3_list_accounts.description: Amounts clients owe for issued invoices.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Freelancer Advances
fin3_list_accounts.description: Money advanced to freelancers or animators before work is approved.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Equipment and Computers
fin3_list_accounts.description: Workstations, tablets, screens and other equipment.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Accounts Payable
fin3_list_accounts.description: Supplier and contractor bills approved but unpaid.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Animator and Freelancer Payables
fin3_list_accounts.description: Approved animator work not yet paid.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Client Deposits and Unearned Revenue
fin3_list_accounts.description: Money received before work is delivered.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Sales Tax / VAT Payable
fin3_list_accounts.description: Tax collected from clients and owed to the tax authority.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Owner Payable
fin3_list_accounts.description: Business costs the owner paid personally and is owed back.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Owner Contributions
fin3_list_accounts.description: Money the owner put into the business.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Owner Draws
fin3_list_accounts.description: Money the owner took out of the business.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Opening Balance Equity
fin3_list_accounts.description: Balancing account for opening balances.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Retained Earnings
fin3_list_accounts.description: Accumulated profit from closed periods. Current-period profit is computed by reports.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Animation Services Revenue
fin3_list_accounts.description: Animation production work invoiced to clients.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Pre-production Revenue
fin3_list_accounts.description: Concept, storyboard and design work.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Post-production Revenue
fin3_list_accounts.description: Compositing, editing and finishing work.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Animator Costs
fin3_list_accounts.description: Cost of animators working on client projects.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Owner Salary
fin3_list_accounts.description: Salary paid to the owner as an expense.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Professional Fees
fin3_list_accounts.description: Accounting, legal and consulting fees.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Bank and Payment Processing Fees
fin3_list_accounts.description: Bank charges, payment provider fees and transfer fees.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Equipment and Supplies
fin3_list_accounts.description: Small equipment and office supplies.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Realized Foreign Exchange Gain
fin3_list_accounts.description: Gain when a foreign-currency amount is settled at a better rate than it was recorded.

fin3_list_accounts.name: Realized Foreign Exchange Loss
fin3_list_accounts.description: Loss when a foreign-currency amount is settled at a worse rate than it was recorded.

fin3_report_cash_flow.note: Cash accounts are those counted by safe-to-spend: active accounts under Cash and Bank, excluding Online Payments Clearing and account reserves.
